datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule throughout 2012 and spatially mapped to administrative or livelihood zones in Rwanda. The classifications represent assessments of acute food insecurity phases at specific time periods (January, April, July, October 2012), providing temporal snapshots of food security conditions.
